title: Team Rhythm · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Team Rhythm · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and agree on a four-beat pattern of claps and pauses. The pair alternates beats so that together they perform the full pattern. The four combined beats match the agreed pattern. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Team Rhythm, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The four combined beats match the agreed pattern.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The four combined beats match the agreed pattern.
